## Executed experiment
On the original real mesh (not primitive assembly), 50 iterations of local adjacency fairing weighted by body/flank mask, posterior adjustment and crown raise. Actual eye domes deform existing vertices: centers X=-.17,+.18, Y=.49, radius .065, amplitude .042 in Z with front mask smoothstep(.36,.64,Z); dark iris via radial color mask. Face projection initially U=.5+.40X, V=.49-.49Y, causing duplicate eyes because source pupil landmarks not aligned. V2 maps U=.56+.46X, V=.51-.46Y; source alpha and front/head masks limit projection, no claim of rear photo texture. Cream RGB 233/218/194, mild normal variation.

New branched down geometry samples original neural triangle surfaces weighted by face area, excluding facial disc and toes with soft masks. Deterministic RNG 381, barycentric surface points and normal/tangent frame. Per root: two tapered shaft triangles and four tapered side barbs on two nodes, real 3D triangles, not image planes; lengths .035 or .052 times random .5–1.4, widths .001–.0015. Fine 18000 roots, full 26000 roots. Three native GLBs per iteration, six exported and reimported successfully. V2 face base 137851/275630 vertices/triangles; fine 461851/383630, 17536684 bytes; full 605851/431630, 22144684 bytes. 24 actual 340x340 VTK offscreen render views (front 0, 45, 90, 180, Y-up), both sheets visually inspected. VTK warned X server connection absent but returned actual rendered pixel buffers and all 24 images. No mobile WebGL acceptance run after art rejection.

## Assessment
V1 duplicate eyes visibly failed; V2 landmark alignment removes duplicate pupil impressions and improves frontal heart disc, but profile eyes remain inset/flat, crown has discolored texture edge, side shows distinct adult folded wing groove and tail projection, exposed toes, and groom looks granular rather than airy cream mesoptile. Fine/full add ~12/17 MB and overdraw risk. Reject all six; not a new neural inference, scientific age validation or release candidate. Do not repeat dense ribbon geometry; investigate reduced short-wing geometry and better volumetric feather clumps with independent side references. No additional charges. No main, concept, deployment or production workflow changes.
